Graduate Application Instructions
Graduate Admissions Deadlines
Domestic Application Deadline (application must be submitted and all other supporting credentials on file) no later than:
14 days prior to the start of the admit term or eCampus session
Some departments require an earlier deadline.*
International Application Deadline (application must be submitted and all other supporting credentials on file) no later than:
Spring 2027 - November 6, 2026
Summer 2027 - March 12, 2027
Fall 2027 - June 18, 2027
(Note: Please check directly with our International Programs and Partnership Office (iss@bgsu.edu) that your program of interest admits for the summer term. Individuals are encouraged to consider applying for fall to ensure compliance with F1 regulations.)
Some departments require an earlier deadline.*
*Academic program deadlines (see table below):
Academic programs may have their own earlier deadlines. Prospective students should check with the academic programs to which they intend to apply for specific application deadlines. Programs may refuse to consider applicants who do not comply with posted deadlines. If your department has an earlier deadline this can be found on their web page and may be listed in the application on the Academic Interest page.
Scholarship funding deadlines (see table below):
Most departments have a deadline for scholarships and/or Graduate Assistant contracts. Contact your department if you have questions about this departmental deadline.
**Please note that there are a very limited number of programs that meet the regulations for international students to receive I-20s with summer start terms. Individuals are encouraged to consider applying for fall.
